system.description:
Olganyar Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Rare, Water. 1 item slot (Worn, RIS Passive).

Prerequisites: Prof[3], Thug, Berserker Rage

This tightly woven armband is soaked through in blood. Wearing it fills you with a sense of unease and mild dread

Luckless Block (Reaction): As a reaction to an enemy successfully hitting you when you are in a Berserker Rage and wear these, you may deal 1D8 Bludgeon damage to them. Increase damage dealt this way to 1D10 at Level 11.

Rulebook p.55.
